description: Complete the mandatory ownership verification for a toolfound submission using the verification token (from the email magic link, or after placing the meta tag / DNS TXT record on your domain — this call checks them on demand). Verification is what makes toolfound listings trustworthy: every launched product is confirmed maker-owned. On success your launch is queued at the transparent position and date you were assigned.

token.description: The verification token from your submission email or verification snippet.

name: toolfound_verify_submission
title: Verify a submission
